complete_acquired_page_coverage.unit: Otho Brunfels dedication to Nicolaus Capito, beginning
complete_acquired_page_coverage.native_heading: PERITISSIMO, ET MVLTA RERVM experientia prædito, Doctori Nicolao Capitoni, inclytæ Vrbis Argent. Medico primario, OTHO Brunfelsius S D.
complete_content_coverage: Criticism of publishers/readers and medical traditionalists, contrast of authorities.
Introduces Dioscorides edition under Capito’s patronage; appeals to Galen and direct ocular/manual investigation and travel.
Biographical notices and discussion of Pliny/Dioscorides precedence.
Four translations listed; Ruellian version chosen.
complete_acquired_page_coverage.border_explanation: No cartouche/scene-number key or concrete animal–plant action attribution encountered.

complete_content_coverage: Adds Hermolaus Barbarus and Marcellus Vergilius commentaries; discusses incompleteness and truncating irrelevant/rhetorical passages.
Corrections from Greek/Latin; gaps/uncertain readings flagged with asterisk, prior borrowed text noted.
Schott supplies index; edition labour/patronage and restoration of medicine praised; dated Argent.,1529.
complete_acquired_page_coverage.border_explanation: No complete pair-specific help/harm/tolerance or feeding explanation encountered.

complete_acquired_page_coverage.unit: Jean Ruel dedication, single complete page
complete_acquired_page_coverage.native_heading: IO. RVELEIVS SVESSIONEN. Antonio Disomo, Regio Consiliario, utriusq[ue] Linguæ peritissimo, S. D.
complete_content_coverage: Laments degeneration of medicine and loss of knowledge of simples.
Restores Greek medical learning via Dioscorides translation and dedicates to Disome.
Nature’s flowers/herbs/fruits/trees as human resources and medical stock; general human benefit asserted.
Translation diction, retained Greek terms and manuscript correction, notably poisons using Paulus Aegineta; dated Paris, Kalends of May, MDXVI.
complete_acquired_page_coverage.border_explanation: General human benefit is not a predicate for each depicted animal. No native linkage to a frontispiece pair.

complete_acquired_page_coverage.unit: Dioscorides preface to Arius, Ruel Latin translation, beginning
complete_acquired_page_coverage.native_heading: PEDACII DIOSCORIDIS ANAZARBEI, in Libros eius, de Medicinali materia, ad ARIVM Præfatio. IO. RVELLIO Suessionensi interprete.
complete_content_coverage: Reviews earlier writers’ incomplete treatment of plants, metals and aromatics, including Crateuas and Andreas.
Criticizes recent writers’ lack of experiential effect evidence and mistaken identifications/claims.
Criticizes alphabetical arrangements separating kinds/effects by adjacency.
Author’s travel, study and composition dedicated to Arius.
complete_acquired_page_coverage.border_explanation: The name Crateuas is discussed among prior herbal authors; this does not assert a therapeutic role for the pictured human or name the pictured plant.

complete_content_coverage: Claims ocular knowledge and concordant testimony, distinctive ordering, relation of simples to mixtures/experiments.
Harvest at proper times, in serene weather; slope/wind/cold/dry locations said to produce stronger virtues than watered/shaded/still-air places, with out-of-time/weak plants less effective.
Early/late growth and seasonal variation, different flowering patterns.
Must observe emergence, maturity and senescence: leaf/stalk/flower/seed differences can cause misidentification, illustrated with grasses/cinquefoil/coltsfoot named in text.
complete_acquired_page_coverage.border_explanation: Actual qualified medicinal-content prose, but no deictic reference or key linking its recipients/effects to specific border associations.

complete_acquired_page_coverage.unit: Dioscorides preface completion, then Thod. Aucuparius poem
complete_content_coverage: Black/white Veratrum preserved for years, other mature herbaceous drugs stated useless; specific collection stages for seeds/flowers/fruits/sap/milk/roots/bark.
Dry/clean storage, washing dirt, odor-preserving linden boxes, seeds wrapped in paper/leaves.
Different materials/vessels for liquids, eye medicines containing vinegar/pitch/cedria, and fats/marrow.
Twelve-line encomium celebrates Dioscorides teaching virtues, causes/natures/history and antidotes; no pair-specific caption key.
complete_acquired_page_coverage.border_explanation: Preface ends within acquired page8. No attached causal explanation of the Aron/Plantago/Dictānus pairs encountered.
